# netcup_scp_user (Data Source)

Get one user

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_scp_user" "example" {
  user_id = 12345
}

output "user_email" {
  value = data.netcup_scp_user.example.email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
